<style>
@import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Neucha&display=swap');

/* Base Fallbacks if Bootstrap fails (e.g. during local preview) */
:root {
  --error-color: var(--bs-body-color, #212529);
  --error-bg: var(--bs-body-bg, #ffffff);
}

/* Hide the default title */
#title-block-header {
  display: none;
}

/* Ensure the main container takes up remaining viewport height to prevent scrolling */
.error-container {
  min-height: calc(100vh - 200px);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  padding: 1rem;
}

.error-container * {
  font-family: 'Neucha', -apple-system, system-ui, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif;
}

/* Sketchy card style using Flexbox to avoid reliance on Bootstrap Grid */
.sketchy-card {
  max-width: 900px;
  width: 100%;
  border: 3px solid var(--error-color);
  border-radius: 255px 15px 225px 15px/15px 225px 15px 255px; /* sketchy border radius */
  box-shadow: 6px 6px 0px var(--error-color);
  background-color: var(--error-bg);
  padding: 2rem;
  
  /* Flexbox Layout to replace Bootstrap row/cols */
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: row;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 2rem;
}

/* Responsive adjustment for small screens */
@media (max-width: 768px) {
  .sketchy-card {
    flex-direction: column;
  }
}

.error-image-container {
  flex: 0 0 40%; 
  width: 100%;
  height: 350px;
  border: 2px solid var(--error-color);
  border-radius: 15px 225px 15px 255px/255px 15px 225px 15px;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.error-image-container img {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  object-fit: cover;
}

.error-message-container {
  flex: 1; 
  text-align: left;
}

.btn-sketchy {
  display: block;
  text-align: center;
  border: 2px solid var(--error-color);
  border-radius: 255px 15px 225px 15px/15px 225px 15px 255px;
  font-weight: bold;
  box-shadow: 3px 3px 0px var(--error-color);
  transition: all 0.2s ease;
  background-color: var(--error-color);
  color: var(--error-bg);
  text-decoration: none;
  padding: 1rem;
  font-size: 1.25rem;
  margin-top: 1.5rem;
}

.btn-sketchy:hover {
  transform: translate(-2px, -2px);
  box-shadow: 5px 5px 0px var(--error-color);
  color: var(--error-bg);
}
</style>

```{=html}
<div class="error-container">
  <div class="sketchy-card">

    <div class="error-image-container">

      <p style="font-size: 1.2rem; line-height: 1.6; color: #6c757d; margin-bottom: 1.5rem;">
        Oops! It seems you've crossed an event horizon into uncharted space. The page you are looking for does not correspond to any valid quantum state in our website's universe.
      </p>

      <a href="https://physicsvoyage-github-io.pages.dev/" class="btn-sketchy">

      </a>
    </div>

  </div>
</div>
```

<script>
// Fix for local Quarto Preview where absolute paths break
if (window.location.hostname === 'localhost' || window.location.hostname === '127.0.0.1') {
  document.querySelectorAll('link[href^="/PhysicsVoyage.github.io/"]').forEach(link => {
    link.href = link.href.replace('/PhysicsVoyage.github.io/', '/');
  });
}

document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() {
  const images = [
    "https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1451187580459-43490279c0fa?w=600&auto=format&fit=crop&q=60",
    "https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1635070041078-e363dbe005cb?w=600&auto=format&fit=crop&q=60",
    "https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1507668077129-56e32842fceb?w=600&auto=format&fit=crop&q=60",
    "https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1506318137071-a8e063b4bec0?w=600&auto=format&fit=crop&q=60",
    "https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1532094349884-543bc11b234d?w=600&auto=format&fit=crop&q=60",
    "https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1464802686167-b939a6910659?w=600&auto=format&fit=crop&q=60",
    "https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1509228468518-180dd4864904?w=600&auto=format&fit=crop&q=60",
    "https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1543722530-d2c3201371e7?w=600&auto=format&fit=crop&q=60"
  ];
  
  const randomImage = images[Math.floor(Math.random() * images.length)];
  const imgElement = document.getElementById("unsplash-random-img");
  if (imgElement) {
    imgElement.src = randomImage;
  }
});
</script>
